newsitem.title: USA: COMEX copper settles firmer but gains pared.
newsitem.headline: COMEX copper settles firmer but gains pared.

text.p: COMEX copper settled firmer but the gains were pared despite a healthy early boost from the second consecutive sharp drop in LME stocks on Wednesday.
The LME reported Wednesday that stocks fell 5,350 tonnes on Tuesday, hard on the heels of a 6,475-tonne drop the previous day.
But after the opening flurry, trading was generally quiet as LME drifted along, unable to make any decisive stab on the upside.

"The market is still very resilient, though some people are looking for a dip on the charts to buy, but I think we will go sideways for a while," a broker said. "The underlying physical tone is still good."
May COMEX copper settled 0.75 cent firmer at 107.65 cents per pound, traded 108.20 to 106.80 cents. Spot April went out 0.55 cent higher at 109.00 cents.
